  1. com.eqixiac.equinix

Uses of Package
com.eqixiac.equinix

Packages that use com.eqixiac.equinix
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix
Root package for the Equinix Java SDK.
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client
Core client infrastructure for the Equinix Java SDK.
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.interfaces
 
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard
The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering
Peering Intelligence: interconnection analysis combining PeeringDB IX/facility data with the live Equinix Fabric catalog.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
Rate cards: pluggable sources of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings
Cloud-egress savings estimation: how much routing a monthly data volume over an Equinix private interconnect saves versus egressing it to the public internet, net of the Equinix interconnect cost.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco
Design-time total-cost-of-ownership comparison across three DeploymentArchetypes — public cloud over the internet, on-premises, and Equinix-interconnected.
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community Model Context Protocol server, not affiliated with or endorsed by Equinix, and unrelated to Equinix's own private-beta Fabric MCP server.
  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix used by com.eqixiac.equinix
    Class
    Description
    CustomerPortal
    The primary entry point for accessing Equinix Customer Portal APIs.
    Design
    A root-level entry point that gathers the SDK's value-add design capabilities — Metro Optimizer, Deployment Wizard, Peering Intelligence, Savings Calculator, and TCO comparison — in one discoverable place, alongside the API-domain clients (Fabric, NetworkEdge, …).
    Equinix
    A single Equinix session that owns one authenticated core client — a single OAuth token and a single HTTP connection pool — and vends every domain client over it.
    EquinixClient
    The base class for all Equinix SDK domain entry points.
    EquinixConfig
    Construction-time options for an Equinix client or Equinix session, passed instead of the bare (credentials, sandbox) arguments when finer control is needed:
    Fabric
    The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Fabric APIs.
    FabricGateway
    Narrow capability view of Fabric that the value-add design engines depend on — the metro/service-profile/cloud-router/connection/routing-protocol resources the optimizer, deployment wizard, and peering intelligence actually use.
    IAM
    The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Identity and Access Management (IAM) API (Access v1) — Equinix's attribute-based access control (ABAC) and role-based access control (RBAC) plane.
    IBXSmartView
    The primary entry point for accessing Equinix IBX SmartView APIs.
    InternetAccess
    The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 API.
    NetworkEdge
    The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Network Edge APIs.
    Projects
    The primary entry point for accessing Equinix Projects APIs.
    STS
    The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Security Token Service (STS) API (STS v1).
